Company description: LOT Polish Airlines, established in 1929, is the flag carrier and largest airline in Poland, recognized as one of the oldest airlines in the world. The airline's partnerships with various global airlines, particularly as a member of the Star Alliance, enhance connectivity and travel options for its customers. With a commitment to excellence, LOT Polish Airlines continuously evolves to meet the changing needs of its passengers and the aviation industry.  The airline is dedicated to enhancing the travel experience through modern aircraft, in-flight entertainment, and exceptional service. Additionally, LOT is actively working on strategies to reduce its carbon footprint and promote sustainable aviation practices, reflecting its commitment to environmental responsibility. By promoting Polish culture and tourism globally, LOT Polish Airlines not only connects Poland with the world but also plays a vital role in the growth of the aviation sector in the region.
